title: Onam outfit ideas for men
description: Onam outfits for men: mundu with kasavu border, kurta options, three budgets with real brands, climate note for Kerala in August.
intro: Onam is a festival of simple, bright white. The classic men's outfit is a mundu or a veshti with a gold kasavu border, worn with a half-sleeve shirt or kurta. The modern option is a cream kurta with chinos. You will sit on the floor for the sadya, so wear something you can sit in. This guide shows both options, three budget looks, and the habits that make the outfit work.

sections.heading: Mundu or modern
sections.body: Traditional is an off-white or cream mundu with a kasavu border, and a plain white or cream shirt or kurta. Some men add an angavastram. Modern is a cream or pastel cotton kurta with chinos or light trousers. The colour is the whole point: cream, off-white, and gold. Avoid black and navy. Keep the border thin for daytime and wider for the Onam sadya or a family visit. Tuck a mundu cleanly before you leave. A loose mundu falls at the worst moment.
tips: Traditional: kasavu mundu, cotton shirt or kurta, flat sandals.
Modern: cream kurta, chinos, leather sandals.

sections.heading: Climate note
sections.body: Onam falls in August or September, in Kerala's monsoon. The air is humid and rain is likely. Choose thin cotton and keep a small umbrella. Light colours show mud, so avoid long dhotis in heavy rain. Carry a spare mundu if you are travelling. Dry the fabric properly before you fold it. Damp cotton in a cupboard grows a smell.

sections.heading: Three looks by budget
sections.body: Prices are approximate. Kerala handloom stores like Kairali and Kerala Handloom sell the best mundus. Fabindia and Manyavar are on Myntra and Ajio for the shirt or kurta.

looks.name: Everyday Onam, tight budget
pieces: Peter England or Van Heusen cream shirt, about ₹1,000
looks.budget_inr: under 1,500 for the mundu and shirt
looks.why: A plain mundu and a clean shirt is the whole outfit. Keep it pressed.

looks.name: Sadya and family visits, mid range
looks.budget_inr: 1,500 to 4,000 for the mundu and kurta each
looks.why: A real kasavu border with a neat kurta looks right at the sadya.

looks.name: Celebration, upper range
looks.budget_inr: 4,000 to 10,000 for the mundu and kurta
looks.why: A good kasavu mundu lasts for years. It also works at weddings.

tips: Buy the mundu first. It is the hardest piece to replace.
Choose handloom cotton. It breathes well in humid weather.

sections.heading: Sitting for the sadya
sections.body: The sadya is eaten on a banana leaf, sitting on the floor. Wear something you can fold into. A mundu is perfect. If you wear pants, choose ones with some stretch. Fold your kurta sleeves back. Keep your phone out of your pocket so it does not dig in. Wash your hands first. After the meal, expect a lot of sitting and a nap. Wear something you can nap in.

sections.heading: How to get the look right
sections.body: The simple outfit is the best one. Keep the shirt or kurta plain and let the kasavu border do the work. Make sure the white is clean and the mundu falls to the ankle, with the border visible at the hem. Choose a half-sleeve cotton shirt if you wear a mundu for the first time, because it is easier to tuck in. Add a thin gold watch or a plain steel one. Skip chains and rings that clash with the border. Wear leather sandals or simple mojaris. For photos, stand with your shoulders back and let the border show. Ask a relative to check the fold before you step out. A good fold makes the outfit.

sections.heading: What to stop buying
sections.body: Stop buying heavy silk mundus for a wet season. Stop buying shiny prints for Onam. Stop buying a new outfit each year in the same colour. Spend on one good mundu and rotate kurtas.

sections.heading: Grooming in one line
sections.body: Keep a clean shave or a trimmed beard, and use a light coconut oil on the hair, as many Malayalis do.

faq.q: What should men wear for Onam?
faq.a: An off-white mundu with a kasavu border and a cotton shirt or kurta. A cream kurta with chinos is the modern option.

faq.q: Can men wear a kurta for Onam?
faq.a: Yes. A cream or off-white cotton kurta with a mundu or chinos works well.

faq.q: What colour is best for Onam?
faq.a: Cream, off-white, and gold. Avoid black and navy.

faq.q: How do I tie a mundu?
faq.a: Wrap the cloth around your waist, tie a firm knot at the front, and fold the loose end. Practise at home before the day. Wear shorts underneath for comfort.
